GenjiSwiftStrikeSwiftAsTheWind.name: Swift as the Wind
GenjiSwiftStrikeSwiftAsTheWind.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Swift Strike increases Genji's Movement Speed by 40% for 3 seconds.

GenjiCyberAgilityAgileDismount.name: Agile Dismount
GenjiCyberAgilityAgileDismount.description: While mounted the range of Cyber Agility is increased by 70%, its cooldown is reduced by 14 seconds, and it Slows enemy Heroes in its landing area by 25% for 2 seconds.

GenjiCyberAgilityPathfinder.name: Pathfinder
GenjiCyberAgilityPathfinder.description: Jumping over terrain with Cyber Agility increases Movement Speed by 30%, and grants Stealth, for 6 seconds. Passive: Genji's Heroic Ability heals him for 10% of the damage dealt to enemy Heroes, increasing up to 30% the lower Genji's Health is.

GenjiShurikenShurikenMastery.name: Shuriken Mastery
GenjiShurikenShurikenMastery.description: Quest: Hit enemy Heroes with Shuriken. Reward: After hitting 30 Heroes, Shuriken damage is increased by 25. Reward: After hitting 60 Heroes, Cyber Agility now refunds 3 charges of Shuriken.

GenjiSwiftStrikeStrikeAtTheHeart.name: Strike At The Heart
GenjiSwiftStrikeStrikeAtTheHeart.description: Enemies hit by the end of Swift Strike take an additional 142 damage after 1 second.

GenjiDeflectDragonClaw.name: Dragon Claw
GenjiDeflectDragonClaw.description: After Genji blocks 330 damage with Deflect, activate to release a Dragon Claw, dealing 190 damage to all nearby enemies.

GenjiDeflectAugmentedGuard.name: Augmented Guard
GenjiDeflectAugmentedGuard.description: When Deflect ends, Genji gains a Shield equal to 100% of the damage blocked for 4 seconds.

GenjiDeflectPerfectDefense.name: Perfect Defense
GenjiDeflectPerfectDefense.description: Deflected damage reduces the cooldown of Deflect by 2.5 seconds, up to a maximum of 12.5 seconds.

GenjiCyberAgilityCyberShield.name: Cyber Shield
GenjiCyberAgilityCyberShield.description: Using Cyber Agility grants 40 Spell Armor for 4 seconds. Passive: Genji dodges 1 Heroic Basic Attack every 5 seconds.

GenjiHeroicDragonblade.name: Dragonblade
GenjiHeroicDragonblade.description: Unleash the Dragonblade for 8 seconds. While active, Dragonblade can be reactivated to lunge forward and slash in a huge arc, dealing 240 damage.

GenjiHeroicXStrike.name: X-Strike
GenjiHeroicXStrike.description: Perform two slashes dealing 145 damage. The slashes detonate after 1.25 seconds causing an additional 290 damage to enemies in their area.

GenjiShurikenShingan.name: Shingan
GenjiShurikenShingan.description: Hitting an enemy with all 3 Shuriken deals 100 bonus damage. Deals 40% less damage to Structures.

GenjiSwiftStrikeFlowLikeWater.name: Flow Like Water
GenjiSwiftStrikeFlowLikeWater.description: Each enemy Hero hit with Swift Strike reduces its cooldown by 4 seconds.

GenjiWayOfTheShimadaTalent.name: Way Of The Shimada
GenjiWayOfTheShimadaTalent.description: Increase Genji's Basic Attack range by 1. Each time Genji hits an enemy Hero with a Basic Attack, increase his Basic Attack damage by 1% for 3 seconds, stacking up to 15%.

GenjiDeflectReflect.name: Reflect
GenjiDeflectReflect.description: Deflect also deals an additional 33% of the damage blocked.

GenjiSwiftStrikeFinalCut.name: Final Cut
GenjiSwiftStrikeFinalCut.description: After 1 second, Swift Strike deals an additional 115 damage to all enemies in the area.

GenjiSwiftStrikeSteadyBlade.name: Steady Blade
GenjiSwiftStrikeSteadyBlade.description: Each enemy Hero hit by Swift Strike increases the damage of the next Swift Strike by 30%. This bonus stacks up to 3 times.

GenjiDragonbladeTheDragonBecomesMe.name: The Dragon Becomes Me
GenjiDragonbladeTheDragonBecomesMe.description: Each time Dragonblade hits an enemy Hero, the duration of Dragonblade is increased by 0.5 seconds. If a Hero is killed within 1.5 seconds of being hit by Dragonblade, Swift Strike's cooldown is reset.

GenjiXStrikeLivingWeapon.name: Living Weapon
GenjiXStrikeLivingWeapon.description: Each enemy Hero hit by X-Strike reduces its cooldown by 12.5 seconds.

GenjiShurikenSharpenedStars.name: Sharpened Stars
GenjiShurikenSharpenedStars.description: Shuriken now pierce all enemies hit. Swift Strike's refund grants 1 charge of Shuriken.

GenjiDeflectZanshin.name: Zanshin
GenjiDeflectZanshin.description: Quest: Block 6500 damage with Deflect, including damage blocked so far. Reward: Deflect hits all nearby enemy Heroes.
